annotations.title: Find company in Peppol e-invoicing network

description: Looks up whether a company can receive e-invoices via Peppol. Search by VAT ID (the usual Peppol identifiers are derived automatically), by a known Peppol participant ID, or by company name. Returns two parts: the Peppol Directory (where listing is voluntary) and, for a VAT ID or participant ID, the Peppol network itself (SML and the provider's SMP), which also finds companies that are not listed in the directory. 'registered' with confirmed: true (the provider's SMP lists business documents) means reachable via Peppol, with the documents it receives; 'registered' without confirmed is only an SML entry and does not prove reachability. 'not registered' only covers the identifiers looked up; the company may use another one. A name search asks the directory only.

country.description: Optional two-letter country code for a name search.

name.description: Company name, if neither VAT ID nor participant ID is known.

participant_id.description: A known Peppol participant ID: four-digit scheme code, colon, identifier, e.g. 0208:0202239951.

vat_id.description: The company's VAT ID or Swiss UID.

with_receipt.description: Optional, default false. Set true only when the user asks for a signed receipt of this check for their files.

name: find_peppol_participant
